主要内容: LendingClub Corp. experienced a significant surge in its valuation following its initial public offering, reaching an $8.46 billion valuation. The company and its backers raised a larger-than-expected $870 million from the IPO, which was priced at $15. Shares closed 56 percent higher at $23.43 in New York, lifting the company’s market value higher than all but 13 U.S. banks, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. This event has brought considerable attention to the peer-to-peer lending industry and set high expectations for its growth potential.
